captive_summary: No captive power identified. No source found describing on-site captive generation for the terminal's own operations -- only this bundled, grid-facing merchant plant concept, which itself was never built.

captive_summary: No captive power. Energy World Corp's own project description states the LNG Hub Terminal exists to 'support our adjacent 650 MW combined cycle gas fired power plant,' which in turn will 'secure gas from the adjacent LNG hub terminal' -- an explicit direction-out (terminal feeds plant) relationship, not captive generation for the terminal's own operations.
